description: This header file declares functions related to assembling and unpacking Android boot images, including vendor boot images, reading Android version info, and handling ramdisk files within the cuttlefish project.
external_methods: Result<void> RepackBootImage(const Avb&, const std::string&, const std::string&, const std::string&, const std::string&)

methods.name: RepackBootImage
methods.description: Repackages a boot image with a new kernel using AVB.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImage
methods.description: Repackages vendor boot image with a new ramdisk.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImageWithEmptyRamdisk
methods.description: Repackages vendor boot image with an empty ramdisk.

methods.name: UnpackBootImage
methods.description: Unpacks a boot image into a directory.

methods.name: UnpackVendorBootImageIfNotUnpacked
methods.description: Unpacks a vendor boot image if it's not already unpacked.

methods.name: RepackGem5BootImage
methods.description: Repacks a Gem5-boot image with initrd and bootconfig.

methods.name: ReadAndroidVersionFromBootImage
methods.description: Reads Android version info from a boot image.

methods.name: UnpackRamdisk
methods.description: Unpacks a ramdisk to a specified directory.

methods.name: PackRamdisk
methods.description: Creates a ramdisk archive from a directory.
